changelog: Shotgun: the Kraken 2 index is now picked from a list (step 3), like the reference database of the amplicon pipelines — every index setup_shotgun.sh installed under databases/kraken2/ (Standard-16, PlusPF-16 with fungi and protozoa, …) with its build date, plus a custom path. The registered default is preselected. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Shotgun MAGs, Nanopore: Medaka polishing is now an option in step 4 (off by default) and runs at 4 threads. At 8 threads, polishing the Zymo Nanopore assembly took the whole WSL down on nextapp (28 GB) and the running job with it. For R10 / SUP reads Flye's own consensus is usually enough; turn it on for older R9 data, where unpolished contigs make CheckM2 understate completeness.
